description_expanded: This Della condo home Is perfectly situated on the top floor of The Della condo building overlooking the Town Center. It features an ideal location providing easy access to shopping, restaurants, and the grassy amphitheater. One of most compelling features of this home is the large balcony offering ample seating which offers beautiful gulf view in the distance. It's the perfect spot to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind in the evening. Inside, you'll find a spacious living room, dining area, and kitchen that are just perfect for cooking and entertaining. The primary bedroom has a king bed and an ensuite bathroom, while the guest bedroom features a cozy queen bed with a conveniently located bathroom just across the hall. Parking is located in a parking court directly behind the building with one reserved space. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
